modelDescription: The Model 2020 Boundary family of bolt action rifles is expertly crafted for unrivaled precision and quality. With a refined carbon fiber stock and a robust hinged floor plate design, the Boundary offers the sleek lines of a classic hunting rifle with premium, modern features. Built on the custom-grade Model 2020 action, the Boundary is available in long and short action configurations and backed by our .75 MOA guarantee.
